{{Top|leg}}
'''Wormturns''' was a command code installed by [[Eurrsk Thri'ag]] on the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]{{'s}} [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in order to gain access to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] auxiliary command bridge.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Battle of Talasea]], the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]{{'s}} command bridge was destroyed by a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] volley from the ''[[Provocateur]]''; a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Imperial frigate]] belonging to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces. With the entire bridge crew dead and the ship floating in space, [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garik Loran]] accessed the auxiliary bridge using the Wormturns command code sliced in by [[Eurrsk Thri'ag]]; who was the squadron's [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]]. After typing in the code, he identified himself through voice and issued the vocal password "Agamar Rules the Galaxy".<ref name="WS" />
